meta.title: File library
meta.description: Search the files you have sent to DSH, view any of them without copying, and reuse them in one click.

scope.workspaceOnlyHint: Only files belonging to this session's workspace are listed.

scopeFallback.no-session: Showing all files instead — no session is attached to this tab.
scopeFallback.invalid-session: Showing all files instead — the session id is not usable.
scopeFallback.unknown-session: Showing all files instead — this session has no resolvable workspace.
scopeFallback.http-404: Showing all files instead — the host did not return a scoped list.

coverage.truncatedUnknown: Some sessions were not indexed because of scan limits.

reuse.rule: Stream or read to view, file a copy to edit.
reuse.footer: “Open” streams the original from the attachment store; “File this” copies one into library/ to edit.

empty.workspaceTitle: No files in this workspace yet
empty.workspaceBody: Files you send in this chat land here. Everything sent in other chats stays one click away under All files.
empty.libraryBody: Everything you send to DSH is kept in a shared attachment store. Send a PDF, image, document or spreadsheet in any chat and it appears here with its original name, ready to search and reuse.
